instruction.name: xvmaddwev.q.du.d
instruction.description: Multiply the even-positioned unsigned 64-bit elements in `b` and the corresponding signed 64-bit elements in `c`, extending both to 128-bit, and add the product to the 128-bit elements in `a`.
